purpose: noise sensitivity of the frozen source-conditioned low-rank operator
noise_definition: zero-mean Gaussian noise with standard deviation equal to clean record RMS divided by 10^(SNR_dB/20)
decision_rule: No model, picker, weight, or search setting may be changed after this protocol is read.
limitations: Synthetic confirmation records, one frozen operator and one receiver geometry; this is a noise-sensitivity test rather than field-data validation.
